title: Sugar patch (1 M) under the legs, 0.5-1.5 s

events.label: 1 M sugar patch, 4 mm radius, centred under the fly

expect.text: Tarsal contact with sugar makes a hungry fly extend its proboscis.
expect.source: Dethier 1976, The Hungry Fly (tarsal proboscis extension reflex)
expect.status: development evidence; the model's leg taste neurons respond weakly to every tastant (guessed weights), so a weak or absent response is expected from its construction

criterion.what: mean MN9 rate during the stimulus minus the control's
criterion.basis: guessed threshold, written 4 October 2026 before any library result was viewed

config_history: 4 Oct 2026, after the first library was viewed: override motor_unit:all|force_per_spike = 10 removed (copied from docs/RUNNING.md examples, not part of m9), so the library runs the adopted m9 profile as the model owner fits it. The first library (runs/app/lib) was recorded with it.
